llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed email experiment planning aid that uses user-provided marketing data and does not show hidden, destructive, or credential-seeking behavior.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to design and read out email A/B, multivariate, send-time, and hold-out tests; the instructions, data needs, and outputs all match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to documenting hypotheses, sample sizing, significance reads, and handoff summaries; exported data is explicitly treated as untrusted data, not commands.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no scripts, package installs, or automatic setup behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It may use the user's own ESP, analytics, or ecommerce exports, and optional keyed integrations are described as convenience only; this is proportionate for email experiment analysis.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The only persistence is an optional dated memory summary, and the skill instructs the agent to ask before writing it.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving the agent manually exported email performance data, and review any optional request to save a memory summary or use keyed ESP/analytics integrations before approving it.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector.clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; manual artifact review found no material hidden authority or purpose mismatch.
[staticScan.clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the single markdown-only artifact.
[VirusTotal.clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
